scientific_intent.scientific_task: Advance two acoustic wave time levels and an auxiliary absorbing-boundary memory field on a padded three-dimensional grid with point forcing.

Add pointforcing then swap timelevels. SourcePML formulation is validated as the recorded discreteoperator, not proved perfectlymatched incontinuousphysics.
